text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #444444

g.text: Apple M2 Pro • float64 • one MPI rank per JAX CPU device • no CPU affinity
Points: median of 3 independent launch medians. Bars: range of launch medians.
Each launch: 7 batches × 100 updates; sample = maximum rank time / 100. Setup and compilation excluded.
1 rank has no remote ghosts; no T(1)-based speedup or ideal 1/p line is asserted.
